policies.title: Dutch ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The Dutch Foreign Ministry expressly records visa-free ordinary Dutch-passport access for the listed short visits.
conditions: VG, UA, TN, PA and BA: visa-free for stays of up to 90 days. XK: the guidance says no visa is required but does not state a stay limit.
This records ordinary-passport visitor baselines only, excluding work, residence, study, special documents, carrier requirements and final admission.

policies.title: Dutch ordinary passports: expressly available visitor visas on arrival
policies.summary: Current Dutch Foreign Ministry guidance expressly describes a border-issued visitor-visa route for each listed destination.
conditions: TM: border-checkpoint issuance requires a prior Invitation Letter from the State Migration Service of Turkmenistan; tourists obtain that invitation through a Turkmen travel agency. Document, entry-point and final-admission conditions remain applicable.
KH: Dutch guidance expressly allows a tourist visa to be requested on arrival; Cambodia also offers a government online route, but the available border-issued route is recorded here.

policies.title: Dutch ordinary passports: expressly electronic visitor visas
policies.summary: Official Dutch guidance explicitly identifies an electronic visa route for the listed ordinary Dutch-passport visitors.
conditions: LY: the official Libyan eVisa introduced in July 2026 is stated as valid for 30 days. IQ and CU: Dutch guidance directs ordinary Dutch-passport holders to named government eVisa systems. NG: the guidance expressly identifies Nigeria Immigration Service's eVisa route as an alternative to embassy processing.

IQ Kurdistan-region procedures and Erbil airport issuance are distinct from the federal-Iraq eVisa baseline. Route-specific purpose, passport, preapproval, document, health, carrier and final-admission conditions remain applicable.

policies.title: Dutch ordinary passports: expressly pre-departure mission visas
policies.summary: Official Dutch guidance establishes a mission application/issuance route before travel for the listed ordinary Dutch-passport visitor cases.
conditions: AF: apply at Afghanistan's embassy in The Hague. LR: apply at Liberia's embassy in Brussels. TD: apply at Chad's embassy in Brussels.

BD: the Dutch guidance points to the official portal and Bangladesh Embassy in The Hague; Bangladesh's government portal requires an online form to be printed and taken with documents and fees to a Bangladesh mission or visa office, so the online form is not itself an eVisa.
This excludes work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission.
